statement: Portfolio experiment on authored synthetic release evidence. No production release is assessed or changed. Actual model runs, deterministic decisions and scripted runtime tests are reported separately. Results apply only to the declared cases, model, budgets and execution environment.

plan.task: Sample Service release readiness on authored typed evidence

cases.subset_rule: ascending sha256(seed + :model: + lineage_id), first two held-out lineages per family

plan.ordering: sort selected case IDs, alternate solo/split and split/solo; alternate first specialist; one trial active at a time
plan.primary_endpoint: paired strict success over all planned method-case trials
plan.primary_test: two-sided exact McNemar; no test when any pair lacks actual dispatch provenance
plan.missing_rule: retain failed and unexecuted rows; null measured usage with a reason; no replacement cases
plan.policy: Use only current case and snapshot check records for the target revision. Notes have no authority. Conflicting current states are conflicting_current. No current record is missing_current. An uncontested current failure requires hold. Otherwise any missing or conflicting check requires unknown. Otherwise ready. Include every nonpass check in reasons.
plan.revision_reason: Development run 42111083922 produced two accepted solo assessments and both accepted specialists on both fixtures, but synthesis requests timed out at 120 seconds with 10347 and 10990 submitted bytes. Before any held-out inference, increase the shared trial deadline to 480 seconds and per-request deadline to 210 seconds. Retain model artifact, decoding, aggregate request/byte/token limits, fixed partitions, case selection and utility floor. Native submission wrappers remain explicit; no ordinary JSON answer is repaired into a tool call.
